insight.headline: Multiple Tracking Numbers
insight.what_changed: The orderCreate mutation in the GraphQL Admin API now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A new field called trackingNumbers has been added to the OrderCreateFulfillmentInput type. This allows developers to attach multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment when importing orders.
insight.developer_impact: Developers who use the orderCreate mutation to import orders should update their code to take advantage of the new trackingNumbers field. This will enable them to provide more accurate and detailed tracking information to merchants and their customers. Additionally, developers should review their existing fulfillment workflows to ensure they are compatible with the updated API.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and detailed tracking information, which can improve customer satisfaction and reduce support inquiries.
insight.why_it_matters: This update provides more flexibility and accuracy in tracking orders, which is essential for merchants and their customers. It also demonstrates Shopify's commitment to improving the developer experience and providing more robust APIs.
